description: This PHP class `GenerateOpenApiDocCommand` defines a console command for generating OpenAPI documentation for the OrangeHRM project. It includes methods to configure the command, execute it by scanning specified paths for API definitions, and output both raw JSON and a Swagger UI HTML file.

classes.name: GenerateOpenApiDocCommand
classes.description: A Symfony Console command class responsible for generating an OpenAPI JSON spec and Swagger UI HTML for the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command options, including the 'throw' option to convert warnings to errors.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution method that runs the API scanning, generates the OpenAPI JSON, writes output files, and handles error handling based on options.
